# clearv1

```go
import clearv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/cache/clear/v1"
```

Package clearv1 is the cache.clear/v1 contract: empty an app's cache buckets from outside the app's code, so its admins (the dashboard, \`pocketone remote cache clear\`, an agent) can drop what cache/v1 keeps for it after a change that left stale entries behind.

A wire contract at /api/\_c/cache.clear/v1, beside cache/v1: whoever provides cache/v1 provides this too.

Source: [`ext/contracts/cache/clear/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/cache/clear/v1).

```go
var W = extkit.NewWire(Contract, "cache", func(inner Clearer, g *extkit.Guard[Clearer]) Clearer {
	return &guardClearer{inner, g}
},
	extkit.Op[Clearer]{
		Name:   "clear",
		Desc:   "Empties one of the app's cache buckets, or every bucket it has.",
		Method: "POST",
		Path:   "",
		Scope:  "cache",
		In:     reflect.TypeOf(ClearInput{}),
		Out:    extkit.OutJSON,
		Invoke: func(ctx context.Context, impl Clearer, a extkit.Auth, req extkit.OpRequest) (any, error) {
			var in ClearInput
			if err := extkit.DecodeInput(req.JSON, &in); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return impl.Clear(ctx, a, in)
		},
	},
)
```

W is cache.clear/v1's wire side: routes at /api/\_c/cache.clear/v1/\<op>, action hooks, MCP tools and the client.

## Functions

### OnClear

```go
func OnClear(owner any, fn func(e *extkit.CallEvent, in *ClearInput) error)
```

OnClear binds fn to clear calls on owner (an app, or a host's scope for calls the host answers). Call e.Next() to continue; return an error to refuse. in is the call's input; changes reach the provider.

Clearer empties an app's cache buckets.

### Client

```go
type Client struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Client is cache.clear/v1 over HTTP, for the CLI and other apps. It implements Clearer; the token it was made with is the credential, so the extkit.Auth argument is ignored.

### NewClient

```go
func NewClient(baseURL, token string, hc *http.Client) *Client
```

NewClient calls cache.clear/v1 on the app at baseURL with token (a PocketBase auth token or an API token).
